```
    # Build members dict

    # Build aggregate edges dict

        cu = refinement.get(u)
        cv = refinement.get(v)
        if cu is None or cv is None:
            raise ValueError("Node not in refinement")
        # Canonicalize undirected
        if cu <= cv:
            key = (cu, cv)
        else:
            key = (cv, cu)
        aggregate[key] = aggregate.get(key, 0) + w
    # Convert to list of lists and sort
    aggregate_edges = [[k[0], k[1], v] for k, v in aggregate.items()]
    aggregate_edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    return {"aggregate_edges": aggregate_edges, "members": members}
```
